page.content:
Pentecost departure that empties Camelot of its best knights.

How Grail Quest connects

  • Ship: Holy Grail — The Grail Quest is the search for the Holy Grail.
  • Character: Galahad — Galahad is the knight who achieves the Grail.
  • Character: Perceval — Perceval is one of the three who see the Grail.
  • Character: Lancelot — Lancelot comes nearest of the sinful knights and still fails.
  • Location: Camelot — The Quest is proclaimed when the Grail appears at Camelot.

What is Grail Quest?

The Grail Quest begins when the vessel appears at Camelot. Most knights fail; Lancelot sees a partial vision; Galahad, Perceval, and Bors reach Corbenic.

Key threads lead to Holy Grail, Galahad, Perceval, Lancelot and Camelot.
